actualPrompt: Paint ONE standalone natural broad-canopied branching deciduous TREE map sprite T04. Input1 is structure/projection ONLY: high orthographic overhead oblique 62.5 degree elevation, vertical trunk, broad lower tiered crown, visible stout trunk forking low into several tapering branches, root flare with complete short roots. Approximate envelope 4.5m broad x4m deep x5.5m tall, candidate only. Replace wire ellipsoids with irregular organically merged layered leaf masses, NOT four spheres. Broad lower asymmetric spreading canopy with multiple levels, not tall narrow columnar tree, not a tree-pit tree with pit removed. Let gaps under and between foliage reveal thick forks and thin limbs. Show broad TOP surfaces of canopy from high oblique view, never frontal eye-level tree elevation. Input2 is approved city-map foliage PAINT/PALETTE authority only: Japanese urban anime painterly miniature, moderately summarized foliage clusters with brush-painted daylight light/shade, deep natural green shadows, mid olive/forest greens, restrained soft highlights, not all yellow-green. No fluorescent leaves. Not photoreal botanical product photo, not black-outlined flat icon or plastic low-poly toy. Upper-left neutral daylight. Actual clean TRANSPARENT background outside complete foliage/branches/roots, no pot/tree pit/soil disk/grass patch/road/ground slab/sky/people/vehicles/buildings/text/logo. No shadow cloud, gray haze, halo. Tiny root bark belongs to tree; no broad earth base. Entire silhouette and all roots inside transparent margins. Remove wire geometry, red dot and all guide lettering. Single tree only.
